intro: Cinq 1500 Tall Sideboard blends refined design language with contemporary versatility. Elevated on a sleek steel frame, it offers generous organisation while maintaining a light, composed presence.

features.title: Contemporary design for organised living
features.text: The tall sideboard introduces additional storage capacity while maintaining a clean and balanced silhouette. Additionally, its understated neutral colour palette blends naturally into a wide range of decor themes, allowing the sideboard to adapt seamlessly as interiors evolve over time.

features.title: Slender steel framework for visual sophistication
features.text: The tubular steel frame introduces a light, structured appearance that adds elegance without visual heaviness, while ensuring dependable everyday stability.

features.title: Expanded internal organisation for practical storage
features.text: Additional drawers and enclosed compartments provide generous capacity for dining accessories, linens, serveware, books, and household essentials. A balanced combination of closed and open storage allows you to conceal essentials while displaying decorative accents or frequently accessed items with ease.

features.title: Raised profile for open spatial flow
features.text: The elevated design creates openness beneath the sideboard, helping interiors feel more breathable while allowing easier floor maintenance.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
